replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is not my favorite subject, as I prefer chemistry and history. My education only went up to upper secondary, so I never really mastered advanced math. I struggle with formulas and often feel intimidated by abstract concepts.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I often feel anxious about math. It reminds me of my struggles in school, and I worry about not being able to understand or solve problems. My high neuroticism doesn't help either; I tend to overthink and get stressed easily.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math learning. I'm a bit skeptical about relying on technology for something as complex as math. Plus, with my part-time job and two kids, I don't have much time to explore these tools.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a technique to reduce data dimensions. You start by standardizing the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix and find its eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Sort eigenvectors by eigenvalues, and project the data onto the top eigenvectors. The math is complex, and yes, it might be anxiety-inducing, but the concept is about simplifying data, so maybe it's not that bad.

Balancing tech with traditional teaching is key.
